newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Finance (HK) loan raised to HK$660 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Finance (HK) loan raised to HK$660 mln.

text.p: Pacific Finance Hong Kong's term loan facility has been increased to HK$660 million from HK$500 million, arranger Dresdner Bank said Tuesday.
The borrower is equally owned by Jardine Matheson & Co and Jardine Fleming Bank Ltd.
The facility has a final maturity of 39 months. Its average life is three years. It pays an interest margin of 50 basis points over Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, all-in return for top-tier managers is 67.3 basis points.
Arrangers with US$85 million each are Bayerische Landesbank and Fuji Bank. Arrangers Dresdner Bank with US$60 million, and Kleinwort Benson with US$30 million.
Co-arrangers with US$50 million each, are ANZ Asia, Bank of Nova Scotia, Cariplo Hong Kong, Royal Bank of Canada, Royal Bank of Scotland, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong, Sumitomo Bank and Tokai Bank Hong Kong.
